picks.title: When God's "Yes" Looks Like a "No"
picks.summary: Oswald Jeffrey Smith was told he was too frail to become a missionary—the very calling he believed God had placed on his heart. But what looked like rejection became redirection, leading him into decades of ministry, preaching, evangelism, and missions around the world. If you're facing a closed door, disappointment, or an unexpected detour, this story is a reminder that God can use a different route to accomplish His purpose. Listen and consider whether your "no" might actually be leading somewhere God has already prepared.   Join the mission. Be part of the impact — support here: 365 Christi
picks.reason: A story about God's guidance through hardship and purpose in ministry.

picks.title: Come Follow Me-Sept. 6-13, 2026-Proverbs
picks.summary: Welcome back to another week at He Is Our Story.  I approach each episode of this podcast trying to answer two questions, “what does this scripture have to do with me, today, in my actual life and what does this scripture teach me about JesusChrist?This week we're sitting in proverbs. This book of wisdom literature that if full of phrases that have become commonplace!  Even people who don’t readthe bible will know some of the proverbs! “Pride goeth before the fall”, “Spare the rod, spoil the child”, “A softanswer turns away wrath”, “As a man thinketh, so is he”.     In light of our new Sunday
picks.reason: Connects Proverbs to daily life and Christ, offering practical Restoration insight.
